description:
Child of C11-336. Depends on R2 merged (state model + bridge); runs in parallel with R3. Contract: docs/markdown-viewer-design.md Agent surface table. Scope: the agent CLI and socket methods, all using `--panel`: - `c11 markdown scroll --panel

--heading ""`: jumps to the section and flashes it briefly in gold; no macOS focus steal, no workspace switch. - `c11 markdown visible --panel

--json`: heading path, line range, progress, theme, typeface, size, open find, selection; `--watch` streams changes. - `c11 markdown theme --panel

--set ` / `--list` (rejects unknown names); `c11 markdown typeface --panel

--set ` / `--list`; `c11 markdown font --panel

--scale ` (validated 0.5–3.0); `c11 markdown open-external --panel

`. - Socket methods under markdown.*: queries off-main per the socket threading policy; only what must touch the web view hops to main; non-focus commands never change focus. Register capabilities/features the way other versioned features are (Sources/CapabilityFeatures.swift). - skills/c11-markdown/SKILL.md (+ references/commands.md, and skills/c11 if it changes) updated in the same PR; installed-skill sync done by the Merge Captain after merge. - CLI tests through the CLI/socket seam (behavioural, no source-grep). Proof: tagged Atlas build, each command driven from a terminal against a markdown panel in a background workspace, with observed results (screenshot for scroll flash).
title: Markdown viewer R4: agent CLI (scroll, visible, theme, typeface, font, open-external) + skill
